```python
def solve(case):
    threshold = case["threshold"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    
    diagnostics = []
    accepted_call_ids = []
    
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        loss_without = call["loss_without_call"]
        loss_with = call["loss_with_call"]
        prediction_tokens = call["prediction_tokens"]
        parseable = call["parseable"]
        
        # Validate required fields
        for field in ("call_id", "loss_without_call", "loss_with_call", "prediction_tokens", "parseable"):
            if field not in call:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing required field: {field}")
        
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        tokens = max(prediction_tokens, 1)
        normalized_gain = gain / tokens
        
        accepted = parseable and normalized_gain >= threshold
        
        diagnostics.append({
            "call_id": call_id,
            "normalized_gain": round(normalized_gain, 8),
            "accepted": accepted
        })
        
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted_call_ids,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
```
